title: A Aftermath for the Wardrobe
author: Xanthe Pemberton
blurb: Cyrus Okonkwo, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
